acceptanceCriteria: A read-only command or an ocm-prepare output lists every extracted claim selector for the cited test files, or the normalization is documented with examples in the OCM spec.
body:
Filed 2026-09-25 from the Beamfall PTR orientation run (beamfall/core#32). A case named `PTR-V0-003 two bound checks versions is tampered` is addressed as `case:ptr-v0-two-bound-check-version-is-tampered`: numeric suffixes are dropped and `checks`/`versions` are singularized. The operator had to probe each fragment through failed `ocm link` calls. No command lists the selectors OCM extracted for a test file.

Reproduced 2026-09-30 during the Corvint build-constraint bug repair, installed Core 1.0.0-rc.1 build 163. Case text BKM-V0-004 go-build-literal must be addressed as case:bkm-v0-go-build-literal; a body comment does not belong to the function-name anchor. Valid unkeyed Go struct-table names are not supported claim anchors; named name/testName/test_name fields or a literal t.Run name are required. Expected read-only selector inventory for the pinned test file, actual repeated claim-obligation-mismatch and claim-selector-out-of-range diagnostics before source inspection. Existing normalization hint was useful, but does not list the extracted candidates. Exact logs: /private/tmp/corvint-bug-hunt-evidence/final-dogfood.log and private Git corvint/ocm-link-001.stderr (subsequent reruns replace these files; root checkpoint retains cause). Repaired task uses keyed name fields and literal exact requirement IDs; no normalization implementation was changed.

Additional 2026-10-01 JS observation on Core rc.1 build163 / Tasks202: linking AHI-020 in integrations/host-adapters.test.mjs refused claim-selector-out-of-range with generic outside-extracted-worklist error. The exact existing test name normalization requires OpenCode -> open-code, bounds -> bound, declarations -> declaration, versions -> version, lists -> list, and a 96-byte truncation. The correct second selector ends while-d, not the full test name. Unlike Go case misses, the JS miss did not print a normalized selector hint. Both final exact claims independently linked and verified. Evidence /private/tmp/corvint-opencode-quiet-context/ocm-links.tsv and bind-both-final.log; immutable product target bc2fccbafbabc09ea3f923661d75bc8bdb7a6004, PR419. Preserve full exact requirement ID in claim anchors; do not weaken extraction admission. Expected a bounded claim-list or actionable normalized JS selector diagnostic so callers do not reimplement producer normalization.
title: ocm: claim selector normalization drops digits and singularizes words, so adopters must guess case selectors
